## Models

## Verification before trusting a model

Each model function must recover a known effect from simulated data with
the same structure before it is run on the study data
(`tests/testthat/test-models.R`).

## Reporting

Effect sizes with 95% CI; p-values to three decimals. State any
multiplicity adjustment, or why there is none.
